title: Atria Pricing 2026: Core, Plus and Business Compared | Sprites
summary: Atria costs $129, $479 or $959 a month billed annually, gated on connected ad spend and AI credits. The full ladder, and how it compares to Foreplay at $59.
body_markdown:
## The short answer


- **$129/mo Core** , **$479/mo Plus** , **$959/mo Business** , billed annually. Enterprise on request.
- The gate is **connected ad spend** — $500K/mo on Core, $1M on Plus, uncapped on Business — not your team size.
- Extra seats are $20 each. Annual billing saves about 20%.
- MCP access (using Atria inside Claude or ChatGPT) is capped at 600 calls on Core, unlimited above it.


Prices read from tryatria.com in September 2026.

## Priced on your spend, not your headcount


Most tools in this category charge per seat. Atria charges for how much connected ad spend it will analyse, which means the tier you need is decided by the accounts you plug in. A three-person team running $1.2M a month lands on Business; a ten-person team running $300K sits on Core.


Worth checking before you buy: add up the monthly spend across every account you would connect, not the one you care about most.

[See all of Atria's ads →](https://www.sprites.ai/ads-library/atria) Their Google account is the older and larger channel, running since September 2025.


## Atria vs Foreplay on price


Atria Foreplay

They are not the same product — Atria connects accounts and generates creative, Foreplay organises and briefs it — but they are sold to the same buyer, and the gap between $59 and $129 is each company's statement about what that buyer wants.
